rationale: Industrial power tool and commercial equipment repair demands absolute trust, durability, and high technical competence. The aesthetic reflects heavy cast iron, precision machined carbide edges, and reliable workshop efficiency without generic SaaS fluff.

paletteIntent.ground: deep industrial graphite slate (dark iron workshop ground with micro-texture)
paletteIntent.raised: machined tool steel elevated surface (crisp technical card container)
paletteIntent.ink: pure optical high-contrast white (maximum legibility across mobile & jobsite conditions)
paletteIntent.inkSecondary: brushed steel muted grey (technical specs, serial numbers, metadata)
paletteIntent.line: precision anodized hairline border (sharp structural gridlines)
paletteIntent.accent: industrial safety amber gold (high-visibility tool calibration & primary action trigger)
paletteIntent.invertedGrounds: light steel workshop ivory (high-contrast printable drop-off confirmation)

refuseList: No neon purple, indigo, or violet-cyan gradients
No generic SaaS glassmorphism cards with multi-color radial blur
No AI-generated fake 3D robot mechanics or cartoon wrenches
No unstyled 90s tables or unformatted part number walls
No low-contrast unreadable grey text on dark backgrounds
No hidden phone numbers or gated multi-step pricing blockers
No generic 3-column feature cards with abstract placeholder icons
